thread:
elaine-docs: Quick sync — PR #452 updates the retention wording around incident logs vs legal holds. I'm not 100% happy with the legal-hold paragraph, feels ambiguous about whether holds override TTLs. Can legal weigh in?

legal-jess: Thanks for the ping, Elaine. We need explicit language. Proposal: 'Data may be retained beyond configured TTL only when a valid legal hold is issued by Legal or Security.' Can you add a short example and a link to the Legal Hold process? :thumbsup:

elaine-docs: Will do. Draft example CLI snippet I was thinking of:
```bash
# export logs under legal hold
redwood export-logs --incident INC-2026-045 --apply-legal-hold 
# metadata: hold_by=legal_jess@example.com hold_until=release_event
```
Is that adequate or too implementation-y?

derek: Slight nit — 'hold_until=release_event' is vague. Suggest showing concrete TTL override for docs: `hold_until=indefinite (released by Legal)` or `hold_until=2027-01-01` with a parenthetical. Avoid 'never' in examples.

maria: Product note — we should clearly state who can issue holds (Legal + Security ops) and link to IAM/roles page. Also call out that holds are scoped to tenant and evidence bucket.

legal-jess: Yep. Also add this sentence verbatim where we talk about SOC 2: 'Legal holds supersede retention TTLs; data subject to a legal hold will remain preserved and accessible only to authorized personnel until the hold is released.' That covers the audit wording.

elaine-docs: Good. One more thing — the doc currently mentions '90 days' for audit logs in one paragraph and '120 days' in another. Which is canonical? We need to reconcile before I merge.

ops-bot: Deploy preview live: https://deploy-preview-452--docs.redwood.ai/security/retention (preview expires in 72 hours)

derek: I can check the storage config. Product usually standardizes on 90 days for general logs; 120 days applies to privileged-access evidence (per compliance pipeline).

maria: Confirmed — standard audit logs = 90d, privileged evidence = 120d. Elaine, can you add a short table and a callout box explaining the exception?

elaine-docs: Will add table with two rows (audit logs: 90d; privileged evidence: 120d) and a callout: 'Legal holds override these periods' with a link to /legal/hold-faq. Also adding a short code example showing `hold_until=YYYY-MM-DD` and a note about KMS/pseudonymization preserved during hold.

legal-jess: That sounds good. One last phrasing tweak for SOC2: change 'may be retained' to 'will be retained under valid legal hold' in the clause to avoid passive ambiguity.

elaine-docs: Done — updating PR and will push within the hour. I'll tag PR as docs/needs-legal and ping for a final quick review. Thanks all. :rocket:

maria: TY! Quick thumbs when ready and we can merge. :thumbsup:
